== Summary ==
Players Committee homepage banner promoting the [[2015 Match Play Championship]]: "Match Play Championship – Join the MPC Madness – May 1–3, 2015 – New Brunswick, NJ" (text in the original banner layout; this file is the background photo strip). The photo shows a crowded play hall at an earlier Players Committee event.

* '''Source:''' starwarsccg.org homepage banner <code>wp/wp-content/uploads/MPCbanner1.jpg</code>. Homepage capture: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150302010823/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 2 March 2015]
* '''Image preserved copy:''' [https://web.archive.org/web/20151103234822/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/MPCbanner1.jpg Internet Archive] (1170×320)
* '''Date:''' banner used March–November 2015; the photo itself is from an earlier event (not stated)
* '''Photographer:''' not stated (Players Committee)
* '''Identification:''' none; the event and the players in the photo are not named.
